I got a pretty severe rash, like most people I never considered the cause could be Keto. I chose the upping of carbs treatment, the rash looked better after one day and was gone within 2 weeks. Website dedicated to the Keto rash

Treatment options
Links for people dealing with the Keto rash

I started getting a small patch of this rash the second day into Keto. I didn't make the connection for quite a while but it kind of comes and goes as it pleases - I'm sure it's because some weeks I eat more carbs than others (never more than 30 net Carbs). This is a great resource though, and I think it would be a great addition to the sidebar or FAQ. I never realized that it was this common, when reading about keto, I think I saw one source mention the 'very rare' side effect of a rash.
